args.title: SLA Update: Support Response Times
args.content:
Effective immediately, our standard support response time target is under 4 hours during business hours. For urgent incidents, please open a ticket from the dashboard and mark it as Urgent.

This update is intended to clarify expectations and improve transparency for customers.
args.excerpt: Clarifying our standard support response time target and escalation guidance.

args.content:
July 2026 API Changelog

This post summarizes API changes shipped in July 2026, including notable fixes, deprecations, and behavior changes.
